lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters; spot size increases and spacing widens on the posterior-lateral flank compared to the high-density, smaller clusters near the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the larger circular centroids to form a non-uniform grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper-most section of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal side and deep shadow immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or irregular indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
